memory.entry_zh: Recoverable fault + HMM + migration + replay；继续把 notifier sequence、VM/context/reset generation、PTE/TLB completion ordering 与 measurement contract 放在第一版 correctness 闭环中。
memory.entry_en: Recoverable fault + HMM + migration + replay; keep notifier sequencing, VM/context/reset generations, PTE/TLB completion ordering and the measurement contract in the first correctness loop.

updates.title_zh: AMDGPU PASID TLB flush fix 再次强调 TLB invalidation completion/ordering 是 correctness boundary
updates.title_en: AMDGPU PASID TLB-flush work reinforces TLB invalidation completion/ordering as a correctness boundary
updates.impact_zh: fault/migration/replay 路径不能把 TLB invalidate 当作尾部 fire-and-forget；必须定义发起、完成、并发 invalidation、reset race 与 replay 可见性。
updates.impact_en: Fault/migration/replay cannot treat TLB invalidation as fire-and-forget; initiation, completion, concurrent invalidation, reset races and replay visibility need explicit semantics.

virt.entry_zh: ASIC capability gate 仍保持；若支持 SR-IOV，则把 PF↔VF admin channel + provisioning/isolation 当作完整 control-plane feature，而不是 generic PCI enablement。
virt.entry_en: Keep the ASIC capability gate; when SR-IOV exists, treat the PF↔VF admin channel plus provisioning/isolation as the real control-plane feature rather than generic PCI enablement.

updates.title_zh: Cisco enic SR-IOV V2 提供成熟 PF↔VF admin-channel 实现参考
updates.title_en: Cisco enic SR-IOV V2 provides a mature PF↔VF admin-channel implementation reference
updates.impact_zh: GPU PF↔VF control 应显式设计 transport/resource ownership、versioned mailbox、request/completion、MSI-X/interrupt、teardown/reset ordering 与 capability negotiation。
updates.impact_en: GPU PF↔VF control should explicitly model transport/resource ownership, a versioned mailbox, request/completion, interrupts, teardown/reset ordering and capability negotiation.
updates.priority_zh: 架构参考现在；实现取决于 ASIC capability
updates.priority_en: Architecture reference now; implementation remains ASIC-gated

power.entry_zh: busy/idle + reusable utilization telemetry → DVFS → runtime PM；本期无方向级变化，继续 measurement/lifetime-first。
power.entry_en: busy/idle + reusable utilization telemetry → DVFS → runtime PM; no direction-level change this run, remain measurement/lifetime-first.

ras.entry_zh: Frozen snapshot + devcoredump + health classification 之后，新增 Reset Gate + reset_generation 作为可复用 recovery primitive。
ras.entry_en: After frozen snapshot + devcoredump + health classification, add a Reset Gate + reset_generation as a reusable recovery primitive.

updates.title_zh: Tyr GPU reset v4 把 reset admission/concurrency 做成显式 KMD 子系统
updates.title_en: Tyr GPU reset v4 makes reset admission/concurrency an explicit KMD subsystem
updates.impact_zh: reset pending 后需要阻止/静默新操作、drain in-flight reader、coalesce 重复 reset，并在重新 admission 前推进 reset_generation；这应成为 snapshot-before-reset 之后的公共 recovery 基础设施。
updates.impact_en: Once reset is pending, new operations need to stop or quiesce, in-flight readers need draining, duplicate resets should coalesce, and reset_generation must advance before admission resumes.
updates.priority_zh: 现在设计；首条生产 reset/recovery 路径实现
updates.priority_en: Design now; implement with the first production reset/recovery path

updates.title_zh: Linux 7.2 晚期 DRM scheduling revert 提醒 recovery/scheduler 改动必须分阶段
updates.title_en: Linux 7.2 late DRM scheduling reverts reinforce staged recovery/scheduler changes
updates.impact_zh: 第一版 reset/recovery 不应同时耦合大范围 scheduler 重写；应通过 state/generation boundary 与 fault-injection tests 分阶段引入。
updates.impact_en: The first reset/recovery implementation should not couple broad scheduler rewrites; introduce changes behind state/generation boundaries and fault-injection tests.

multi.entry_zh: Stable identity → topology → P2P capability → peer mapping → P2P DMA → shared VM；本期无生产级方向变化。
multi.entry_en: Stable identity → topology → P2P capability → peer mapping → P2P DMA → shared VM; no production-level direction change this run.

obs.entry_zh: Stable object/event IDs + low-overhead counters + eBPF trace；未来 hardware trace / PMU 尽量接入 perf-compatible timeline。
obs.entry_en: Stable object/event IDs + low-overhead counters + eBPF tracing; future hardware trace/PMU should join a perf-compatible timeline where practical.

updates.title_zh: perf AUX kernel-consumer work 为 hardware-generated trace stream 接入通用 Linux observability 提供方向
updates.title_en: perf AUX kernel-consumer work points toward common Linux consumption of hardware-generated trace streams
updates.impact_zh: 未来 GPU PMU/trace 若硬件允许，应保留 perf-compatible event/stream semantics，避免形成只被 vendor tool 消费的封闭数据通路。
updates.impact_en: Future GPU PMU/trace should preserve perf-compatible event/stream semantics where hardware allows, avoiding a closed vendor-only data path.

fw.entry_zh: Versioned async protocol + capability negotiation + explicit boot/reset generation；新增 stable capability/property object 作为 DRM/VFIO/其他 upper clients 的唯一 lower-service 输入。
fw.entry_en: Versioned async protocol + capability negotiation + explicit boot/reset generations; add a stable capability/property object consumed by DRM/VFIO and other upper clients.

updates.title_zh: Nova parameter-export v4 把 GPU property 从 nova-core 暴露给 nova-drm
updates.title_en: Nova parameter-export v4 exposes GPU properties from nova-core to nova-drm
updates.impact_zh: capability negotiation 不应只得到 bitmap 后四处判断；应生成 typed/stable internal capability/property object，upper layer 只消费该对象，不穿透 FW/HW 私有状态。
updates.impact_en: Capability negotiation should produce a typed/stable internal capability/property object consumed by upper layers instead of scattered checks or direct FW/HW access.

updates.title_zh: Nova PRAMIN 展示 typed MMIO/window service 也应归 lower-layer ownership
updates.title_en: Nova PRAMIN shows typed MMIO/window services as lower-layer ownership
updates.impact_zh: Control Plane 不只负责消息 transport；若 ASIC 存在 indirect window/MMIO shared service，也应集中 ownership/lifetime，避免 upper module 竞争重编程窗口。
updates.impact_en: The control plane is more than message transport; shared indirect-window/MMIO services should centralize ownership/lifetime so upper modules cannot race reprogramming.
updates.priority_zh: 有对应硬件时作为架构参考
updates.priority_en: Architecture reference when analogous hardware exists
